# discovery

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/adapters/kubernetes/spec/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Kubernetes-owned discovery profile, recognizer inputs and partition coordinates.

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery` is one of connectors_kubernetes's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `KubernetesRecognitionInput`

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery.KubernetesRecognitionInput` is a record of five fields:

- `service_name` — `String`
- `app_name` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `legacy_app` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `legacy_k8s_app` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `legacy_name` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `ObservationProfile`

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery.ObservationProfile` is one of `kubernetes-service-targets`.

### `PartitionCoordinates`

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery.PartitionCoordinates` is a record of three fields:

- `id` — `String`
- `kind` — `connectors_kubernetes.discovery.PartitionKind`
- `namespace` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

Every value satisfies `(not (kind == namespace) or defined(namespace))` and `(not (kind == cluster) or not (defined(namespace)))`.

### `PartitionKind`

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery.PartitionKind` is one of `namespace` and `cluster`.

### `RecognitionProvider`

`connectors_kubernetes.discovery.RecognitionProvider` is one of `grafana`, `alertmanager`, `loki`, `prometheus` and `argocd`.

Four of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors_kubernetes.discovery.KubernetesRecognitionInput`, `connectors_kubernetes.discovery.ObservationProfile`, `connectors_kubernetes.discovery.PartitionCoordinates` and `connectors_kubernetes.discovery.RecognitionProvider`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
